'''Ravi P. Agarwal''' (born July 10, 1947) was an Indian [[mathematician]], Ph.D. sciences, professor, professor & chairman, Department of Mathematics Texas A&M University-Kingsville, Kingsville, U.S. Agarwal is the author of over 1000 scientific papers as well as 30 monographs.<ref name="Google Scholar Citations">{{Cite web |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fyxMWRsAAAAJ&hl=en |title=List of works on Google Scholar Citations |access-date=2016-11-14 |archive-date=2016-04-19 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160419014012/http://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fyxMWRsAAAAJ&hl=en |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was previously a professor in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at [[Florida Institute of Technology]].
